XML — Recipe Book (cook.xml)

cook.xml

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="cook.xsl"?>
<cookbook xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
  xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="cook.xsd">
  <recipe name="鸡丝沙拉">
    <ingredient amount="1" unit="个">鸡胸肉</ingredient>
    <ingredient amount="1" unit="个">柠檬</ingredient>
    <ingredient amount="2" unit="片">生菜</ingredient>
    <image src="chicken.jpg"/>
    <steps>
      <step number="1">将鸡胸肉煮熟切丝。</step>
      <step number="2">柠檬挤汁。</step>
      <step number="3">生菜切丝，与鸡丝、柠檬汁拌匀。</step>
    </steps>
  </recipe>
  <recipe name="焦糖布丁">
    <ingredient amount="2" unit="个">鸡蛋</ingredient>
    <ingredient amount="200" unit="ml">牛奶</ingredient>
    <ingredient amount="30" unit="g">白糖</ingredient>
    <image src="custard.jpg"/>
    <steps>
      <step number="1">鸡蛋打散加入牛奶搅匀。</step>
      <step number="2">加入白糖搅拌至融化。</step>
      <step number="3">隔水蒸 15 分钟至凝固。</step>
    </steps>
  </recipe>
</cookbook>

cook.xsd (Schema)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <xs:element name="cookbook">
    <xs:complexType>
      <xs:sequence>
        <xs:element name="recipe" maxOccurs="unbounded">
          <xs:complexType>
            <xs:sequence>
              <xs:element name="ingredient" type="xs:string" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
              <xs:element name="image">
                <xs:complexType>
                  <xs:attribute name="src" type="xs:string"/>
                </xs:complexType>
              </xs:element>
              <xs:element name="steps">
                <xs:complexType>
                  <xs:sequence>
                    <xs:element name="step" maxOccurs="unbounded">
                      <xs:complexType>
                        <xs:simpleContent>
                          <xs:extension base="xs:string">
                            <xs:attribute name="number" type="xs:integer"/>
                          </xs:extension>
                        </xs:simpleContent>
                      </xs:complexType>
                    </xs:element>
                  </xs:sequence>
                </xs:complexType>
              </xs:element>
            </xs:sequence>
            <xs:attribute name="name" type="xs:string"/>
          </xs:complexType>
        </xs:element>
      </xs:sequence>
    </xs:complexType>
  </xs:element>
</xs:schema>

cook.xsl (Transformation)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform">
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <html><body>
      <xsl:for-each select="cookbook/recipe">
        <h1><xsl:value-of select="@name"/></h1>
        <xsl:for-each select="ingredient">
          <p><xsl:value-of select="."/></p>
        </xsl:for-each>
        <img>
          <xsl:attribute name="src">
            <xsl:value-of select="image/@src"/>
          </xsl:attribute>
        </img>
        <ol>
          <xsl:for-each select="steps/step">
            <li><xsl:value-of select="."/></li>
          </xsl:for-each>
        </ol>
      </xsl:for-each>
    </body></html>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
